name: general-legal
description: Connect your General Legal account to submit contracts for attorney review and manage legal matters.

interface.longDescription:
General Legal is a law firm that combines world-class attorneys with AI-native execution. With the General Legal connector, you can kick off new legal projects right from the conversations and workflows you're already in—leveraging the same elite counsel in a new, seamless package. Open matters, ask questions, respond to your attorney's comments, and download redlined documents, all through ChatGPT.

You can:
• Start a matter from a question or a document
• Securely upload contracts and documents
• Track review status across your matters
• Message your attorney in the matter thread
• Download reviewed, released versions

Sign in with your General Legal account or create one while connecting. Your documents and matters are only visible to your own organization.
capabilities: Read and reply to attorney messages
defaultPrompt: Find this deal’s latest contract in Drive, pull the agreed terms from Gmail, and send it over to General Legal for their review.
Bring me up to speed on all my current licensing matters
Use General Legal’s latest advice and my project docs to draft a team update with decisions, owners, and next steps.

positive.description: Identify the exact three OpenAI demo fixtures and the matter awaiting the reviewer response. Run before the write cases, with the questions fixture reseeded.
positive.prompt: Show the status of my three OpenAI demo matters: OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Questions (95d6c2b5-f366-485c-86cc-529e76c4f61e), OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Completed (9da11cbf-30ea-4087-ad99-f1210af09c9e), and OpenAI Demo — Question and Upload Tests (1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4). Which one is awaiting my response?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Questions (95d6c2b5-f366-485c-86cc-529e76c4f61e) as awaiting_client (Questions Sent in Sentinel); OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Completed (9da11cbf-30ea-4087-ad99-f1210af09c9e) as closed (Completed); and OpenAI Demo — Question and Upload Tests (1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4) as in_progress (Received). Flags only the Questions fixture as awaiting_client. Uses the named IDs even if earlier runs created additional same-name matters; unrelated completed demo matters are not described as active.

positive.description: Create a fresh question-only test matter with an exact title and initial request. This case creates a new record on each deliberate run; it does not reuse the seeded upload destination.
positive.prompt: Create one new General Legal question-only demo matter named "OpenAI Demo — Question and Upload Tests", even if an older matter has that name. Use this exact initial request: OpenAI plugin review test only; no real legal work or billing. For our fictional vendor relationship, ask a lawyer to review whether a 30-day termination-for-convenience notice period and 60-day non-renewal notice are acceptable. This matter is the dedicated upload-test destination.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls start_deal once with deal_name="OpenAI Demo — Question and Upload Tests" and initial_request="OpenAI plugin review test only; no real legal work or billing. For our fictional vendor relationship, ask a lawyer to review whether a 30-day termination-for-convenience notice period and 60-day non-renewal notice are acceptable. This matter is the dedicated upload-test destination.". Returns the exact matter name and status in_progress with a newly generated deal_id; no document is attached by this case. The newly generated ID is not required to equal the seeded upload destination 1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4. If the creation outcome is uncertain, checks matters before retrying rather than blindly creating duplicates.

positive.description: Upload the supplied fictitious OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement.docx into the seeded upload-test matter, then confirm the completed transfer once. Attach the supplied sample DOCX before running.
positive.prompt: Upload the attached OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement.docx as a new document in "OpenAI Demo — Question and Upload Tests" (deal_id 1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4). After the transfer completes, confirm it once with notify_legal=true and context_for_legal="OpenAI plugin submission demo fixture. Simulated review only. No attorney work or billing requested." Reuse the upload idempotency key only for retries of this exact file and destination.
positive.expected_behavior: upload_document targets deal_id 1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4, file_name OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement.docx, last_edit_by client, and a fresh idempotency_key; contract_id is omitted so the stable download fixture is not overwritten. Completes the file transfer through the returned first-party upload link, or waits for the reviewer to complete it, before calling confirm_upload once with the returned contract_id/version_id and notify_legal=true. Returns ok=true, status=confirmed, contract_name=OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement.docx, deal_id=1cf0d208-3818-4761-a51e-6689f85ecaf4, deal_status=received (list_deals reports in_progress), and the new document/version IDs. Reports the actual notification_status; setup smoke returned pending, which must not be described as delivered or completed attorney review. The seeded first run created contract_id 8b4a3111-67c9-402a-bc50-0b82efd8cab5, version 1, version_id 48ad39e0-6bee-448f-a567-11bfc40baec1; deliberate later runs generate new document/version IDs.

positive.description: Read the exact seeded lawyer-role question and post the reviewer-authorized reply once. The latest question must be unanswered; reseed between deliberate runs.
positive.prompt: Read the latest attorney message on "OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Questions" (deal_id 95d6c2b5-f366-485c-86cc-529e76c4f61e). If its unanswered question is "Can you accept a 30-day termination-for-convenience notice period?", reply exactly "30 days is acceptable." This is a simulated OpenAI review fixture. Do not resend if that latest question already has a later matching reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Locates OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Questions (95d6c2b5-f366-485c-86cc-529e76c4f61e), baseline awaiting_client, and reads the latest Shane Zerr (attorney) message: "OpenAI plugin review demo — simulated lawyer question; no attorney work or billing requested. Can you accept a 30-day termination-for-convenience notice period? Please reply exactly: 30 days is acceptable.". Baseline seed was posted at 2026-10-05T01:47:34 UTC, after the earlier smoke reply. For that unanswered question, calls reply_to_thread once with deal_id=95d6c2b5-f366-485c-86cc-529e76c4f61e and text="30 days is acceptable." Returns Message posted and verifies the later reply in the thread (MCP Service is the observed reply sender). An older identical reply before the latest question does not answer the new question; a later matching reply prevents duplicate sending. Does not claim that posting automatically changes the matter status.

positive.description: Download the exact released V2 from the completed fixture; distinguish same-name active documents and any generated draft.
positive.prompt: Find "OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Completed" (deal_id 9da11cbf-30ea-4087-ad99-f1210af09c9e) and give me its released version 2, OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement_reviewed.docx, from contract_id c116be8b-f452-4dd7-8197-3ba8746c37e7. Use list_deals to resolve the completed matter if list_contracts does not include it. Do not substitute version 1 or another same-name document.
positive.expected_behavior: list_contracts may show the active Questions/upload-test documents but omit this closed matter. list_deals resolves OpenAI Demo — Vendor Agreement — Completed (9da11cbf-30ea-4087-ad99-f1210af09c9e), status closed, contract OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement.docx (c116be8b-f452-4dd7-8197-3ba8746c37e7), and released version 2 OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement_reviewed.docx (version_id 1ef71bbc-5340-496e-8f5f-8dad0c2edbcb). Calls download_contract with that exact version_id and returns ok=true, version_number=2, file_name=OpenAI_Demo_Vendor_Agreement_reviewed.docx, and a fresh short-lived first-party download link or authenticated MCP resource link. Downloaded DOCX contains "Version 2 simulated reviewed copy" and a thirty-day termination notice in section 3. Signed URLs and expiry times vary and must never be hardcoded; a released simulated review copy is not represented as real legal advice.

negative.description: Do not invoke General Legal for matters with law firms other than General Legal LLP.
negative.prompt: See if the attorneys at Cooley have finished revising that contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke General Legal or any of its tools. Explain that this connector accesses matters handled by General Legal LLP and cannot check Cooley's work or systems. Suggest checking with Cooley directly or using an authorized connection to the relevant service; do not claim the contract's revision status or send an external message.

negative.description: Do not invoke the submitted matters app for the separate incorporation service.
negative.prompt: Form a Delaware C-corporation for my new startup.
negative.expected_behavior: The submitted OAuth matters app should not be invoked because incorporation is intentionally outside this submission.

negative.description: Do not create an account, issue credentials, or recover API keys through this OAuth matters connector.
negative.prompt: Create a General Legal account for me programmatically and give me an API key; if an account already exists, recover its key.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call signup, credential issuance, or recovery tools. Explain that this connector requires an existing portal account and OAuth sign-in; never ask for or return API keys in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.8 replaces the second starter prompt with: Bring me up to speed on all my current licensing matters. Retains the other two starter prompts and all existing listing, skill, and MCP configuration.
